Processing argument: Enables unfiltered SSHJ TRACE logging for SSH and SFTP operations when log_level is set to TRACE .
false (default)
By default, TRACE logging is suppressed for the following classes to prevent sensitive packet data from being exposed in logs and to avoid excessive log output during file transfers:
net.schmizz.sshj.transport.Encoder
net.schmizz.sshj.transport.Decoder
net.schmizz.sshj.connection.channel.direct.SessionChannel
true
TRACE logging is no longer suppressed for the classes listed above.
Note:
Enabling unfiltered TRACE logging may expose sensitive data in log files and significantly increase log output.
The output can quickly exceed the limits configured in JOC Cockpit Settings:
the Max. display size (default 10 MB), so that the log can only be downloaded, or
the Max. log size (default 50 MB), resulting in log truncation.
Therefore, log_sshj_trace_unfiltered = true should preferably be used for troubleshooting connection problems rather than enabled permanently, and disabled again afterwards.
